name: Stage 54: Karlfors kvarn to Gisekvarn
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 54, Karlfors kvarn to Gisekvarn.
utilities: Månbacken bus stops are the closest public transport to the Karlfors start, about 0.2-0.3 km away. Bergs Gård is the most useful mapped bus access near the Gisekvarn end, about 1 km away; Vagnhärad station is remote regional rail access.

Karlfors/Månbacken has parking and rest context near the start. Månbacken also has a toilet, fireplace/rest point, and bookable cottages, but the cottages are paid lodging rather than free trail shelter.

Björken has the main stage-54 rest-shelter/fireplace area and a nearby dry toilet, but it should not be presented as a planned overnight option because Nynäs reserve overnighting is limited to designated places and current Nynäs guidance points campers to Brevik/Sandviks camping. Gisesjön/Prins Alexanders plats has an accessible picnic/rest cluster with toilet, firepit, rest-shelter context, and waste basket, but a 2026-04-09 Nynäs notice says the Gisesjön shelter/grill place burned and is currently unusable until rebuilt.

Gisekvarn has the official pump at Kvannestigen, a lower-confidence second pump at Älgörtsstigen, parking/recycling by the stage end, and stage-55 continuation. Treat pump water as current-check because older hiker and association reports raise quality concerns.
waterSources: The Kvannestigen pump at Gisekvarn is the strongest verified refill point, but hiker reports have described cloudy water in the past and older local association notes mention failed water tests for some pumps; run it, inspect it, and filter/boil if needed.
Älgörtsstigen is a plausible second pump from community/secondary sources, but it is lower confidence than Kvannestigen and should be verified on site.
Björken and Gisesjön are natural lake water only, not potable taps. Treat/filter/boil and do not move wet gear between lakes because of the official crayfish-plague hygiene warning at Björken.
A possible Månbacken spring/source appears in secondary data, but Nynäs lodging guidance says cottage guests should bring drinking water; do not rely on Månbacken as a potable refill.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden and Naturkartan list stage 54 as 8.5 km. The local drawn geometry measures about 8.245 km, Naturkartan geometry about 8.167 km, and OSM relation 6568069 about 8.024 km despite its stale/wrong 7.5 km distance tag. Keep official distance for planning and measured geometry for map display.

Stage 50:1 joins stage 54 near Björken at the connector before the Björken shelter, and should appear as a route-builder connector only after the user selects the relevant Björken part of stage 54. Nynäs Runt uses only Karlfors-to-Björken on stage 54, then turns onto 50:1.

This Nynäs Runt section uses the old mill path from Karlfors, a steep opening climb/descent depending on direction, rocky forest and hällmark, lake/rest areas, and about 1.5 km of old Trosa road walking near Gisekvarn's summer-house area. Watch traffic on the road section and use care on wet rock, mud, dam slopes, and downhills after rain.

Nynäs reserve rules apply: overnighting in tent, hammock, or shelter is allowed only at designated places and max one consecutive night; fires/grilling only at reserve-managed fireplaces using provided wood; disposable grills are forbidden.
Björken has an official crayfish-plague hygiene warning. Avoid moving wet swimwear, fishing gear, bottles, or other wet equipment between lakes without drying/cleaning.

Fishing is prohibited in reserve parts of Björken and Gisesjön; Trosa municipality separately says there is no general fishing in Gisesjön. Check posted signs and current Nynäs reserve rules before fishing anywhere nearby.

Official Stage 54 showed no current fault report during this pass. Older hiker reports mentioned confusing markings near Gisesjön and later corrections by maintainers, plus a 2022 bark-beetle reroute; keep a map handy at Gisesjön junctions but do not treat those older reports as current closure notices.

Länsstyrelsen published a 2026-04-17 decision that planned lowering of the dam water level at Karlfors kvarn was not expected to cause significant environmental impact. Treat as start-area dam/water-work context, not a trail closure.

facilities.name: Karlfors kvarn stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start at the old mill area, connecting from stage 53 toward Gisekvarn/stage 55. Local line geometry starts a few metres away, but this is the preferred official trailhead point.

facilities.name: Karlfors kvarn rest shelter
facilities.description: Official start-side rest shelter/rastskydd context at Karlfors kvarn. Use as a rest facility, not a guaranteed overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Karlfors dam water-level notice
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen published a 2026-04-17 decision about planned lowering of the dam water level at Karlfors kvarn/Nynäs 1:1, judged not to have significant environmental impact. Start-area context only; no trail closure was verified.

facilities.name: Karlfors/Månbacken parking
facilities.description: Mapped parking near the Karlfors/Månbacken start area. Check local signs before leaving a car for longer periods.

facilities.name: Månbacken bus stop, west platform
facilities.description: Closest mapped bus access to Karlfors, roughly 0.2-0.3 km from the stage start. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken line 554 routing.

facilities.name: Månbacken bus stop, east platform
facilities.description: Opposite platform for Månbacken bus access near the Karlfors start. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken before relying on service.

facilities.name: Smedstorp torp ruin
facilities.description: Route-side cultural-history context about 1 km after Karlfors. Look but do not disturb ruins or remains.

facilities.name: Månbacken toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet near Månbacken and the route. Separate from the bookable cottage lodging nearby.

facilities.name: Månbacken fireplace/rest point
facilities.description: Mapped BBQ/fireplace/rest context near Månbacken. Reserve fire rules and fire bans still apply.

facilities.name: Månbacken cottages
facilities.description: Bookable Nynäs/Månbacken cottage lodging, not a free shelter or public water guarantee. Confirm booking, opening, and water logistics before planning around it.

facilities.name: Månbacken source caveat
facilities.description: Secondary data suggests a source/spring near Månbacken, but it is not a reliable potable refill and conflicts with lodging guidance to bring drinking water. Treat/filter and carry backup.

facilities.name: Björken stage 50:1 connector
facilities.description: Stage 50:1 joins stage 54 near Björken, before the shelter area. In the route builder, show this connector only when the selected stage-54 range reaches the Björken connector area; do not snap it to the shelter.

facilities.name: Björken rest shelter and fireplace
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest point by Sjön Björken with fireplace nearby. Use as a rest shelter, not a planned overnight option: Nynäs reserve rules limit overnighting to designated places and current Nynäs camping guidance points hikers to Brevik/Sandviks camping unless managers say otherwise.

facilities.name: Björken fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace by the Björken shelter/rest area. Fires are allowed only at managed fireplaces with provided wood and subject to current fire bans.

facilities.name: Björken dry toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet near the Björken shelter area.

facilities.name: Sjön Björken natural water
facilities.description: Lake water only, not a potable tap. Treat/filter/boil before drinking and respect the crayfish-plague hygiene warning.

facilities.name: Björken crayfish-plague hygiene warning
facilities.description: Official warning: do not spread crayfish plague by moving wet bathing gear, bottles, or other equipment between lakes without drying/cleaning.

facilities.name: Gisesjön / Prins Alexanders rest shelter
facilities.description: Accessible picnic/rest-shelter context at Prins Alexanders plats near Gisesjön. Nynäs notice from 2026-04-09 says the shelter/grill place burned and is currently unusable while rebuilding is planned; SVT separately reported the fire on 2026-04-06/07. Verify on site before relying on it.

facilities.name: Gisesjön / Prins Alexanders toilet
facilities.description: Toilet at the Prins Alexanders/Gisesjön rest cluster. This corrects the earlier too-far-east app pin.

facilities.name: Gisesjön / Prins Alexanders firepit
facilities.description: Prepared firepit/grill area at the Gisesjön rest cluster, but a 2026-04-09 Nynäs notice says the grill place/shelter burned and is unusable until rebuilt. Use only after current local confirmation and when reserve/fire-ban rules allow.

facilities.name: Gisesjön waste basket
facilities.description: Mapped waste basket at the Prins Alexanders/Gisesjön rest cluster. Pack out waste if the bin is full or unavailable.

facilities.name: Gisesjön natural water
facilities.description: Lake/bathing water only, not a verified potable refill. Treat/filter/boil and note that fishing is prohibited in the reserve part of Gisesjön; avoid spreading organisms between lakes.

facilities.name: Gisesjön overnight/camping caveat
facilities.description: Older/secondary maps mark a backcountry/campsite-style point nearby, but current official reserve rules allow overnighting only at designated places and the 2026 notice says the Gisesjön shelter/grill place is unusable. Do not treat this as legal camping without current signs.

facilities.name: Havrevreten lodging/glamping
facilities.description: Paid seasonal lodging/glamping/hammock-hotel option near the stage 54/55 planning area. Confirm exact location, availability, and transfer/logistics directly.

facilities.name: Gisekvarn Kvannestigen pump
facilities.description: Official pump/water point near Gisekvarn, about 110 m off route. Past hiker reports mentioned cloudy water and older local association notes mention failed pump-water tests, so inspect, run the pump, and filter/boil if needed.

facilities.name: Älgörtsstigen pump
facilities.description: Second pump reported near Älgörtsstigen in secondary/community data. Lower-confidence than the official Kvannestigen pump; verify on site.

facilities.name: Gisekvarn stage end and recycling area
facilities.description: Official Stage 54 end and Stage 55 start area by Gisekvarn/recycling-station access. The mapped recycling/parking node is nearby at about 58.875093, 17.421662; exact parking rules should be checked locally.

facilities.name: Bergs Gård bus stop, west platform
facilities.description: Closest useful mapped bus access near the Gisekvarn end, roughly 1 km off route. Check Sörmlandstrafiken line 554 and weekday/seasonal patterns.

facilities.name: Bergs Gård bus stop, east platform
facilities.description: Opposite Bergs Gård bus platform for end access near Gisekvarn. Verify live departures before relying on it.

facilities.name: Vackebol bus access
facilities.description: Mapped bus access option roughly 2 km from the Gisekvarn end; mark as distant/off-route when shown for this stage.

facilities.name: Gisekvarnsvägen bus access
facilities.description: Named bus stop pair on the road corridor, but not the closest end access; treat as off-route and verify live service.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station remote rail access
facilities.description: Remote rail access for taxi/bus planning, about 9 km direct-line from Gisekvarn and farther from Karlfors. Not a nearby trailhead station.
